summary: Negotiated 'green tier' sustainability discount missing from invoice after Private->Hosted fallback
description: Issue summary: Customer reports that an agreed sustainability discount ("green tier") did not appear on their March invoice after a brief fallback from their Private deployment to Hosted during a VPN failover. Impact: customer was invoiced ~€24k higher than expected for heavy embedding and streaming traffic on 2026-02-10. Environment: Private deployment (VPC) in eu-west with Hosted fallback enabled. Expected: green-tier discount applied to usage served by Private nodes; fallback to Hosted should be billed at standard hosted rates but marked for later credit reconciliation per contract.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer ran high-volume batch embed job on 2026-02-10 between 01:30-03:10 UTC
2) Private edge experienced VPN reconnect, automatic fallback to Hosted was triggered for ~95 minutes
3) Postback events for fallback period were received by billing but did not include the 'private_origin' tag expected for green-tier reconciliation
4) Final invoice shows full-hosted rates for the fallback window and no provisional credit applied for the green-tier contract clause
logs: 2026-02-10T02:10:44Z postback-collector WARN missing tag 'private_origin' for org=verdehealth request_id=8a7c3f
billing-reconciler ERROR failed to map postback to negotiated_rate_id: null for batch_window 2026-02-10T01:30/03:05
comments: 2026-02-18 - Aisha Raman (Support): Customer submitted invoice diff showing delta +€24,183 and contract excerpt referencing green-tier discount for private-hosted hybrid with reconciliation clause.
2026-02-18 - Billing (Elena Park): Assigned to billing queue; initial hypothesis is missing postback tag leading to rate lookup failure. Requesting postback raw payloads for fallback window.

2026-02-19 - SRE (Marcus Li): Found that during VPN reconnection the postback forwarder retried via a proxy which strips custom header X-Private-Origin. Attached proxy access logs and forwarder config snippet to the ticket (see related_github_prs).
2026-02-20 - Support (Aisha): Sent a detailed repro and asked customer for job IDs and sample request_ids. Customer provided batch job id BH-20260210-77 and request_ids 8a7c3f, a9f34b.
2026-02-21 - Billing (Elena): Run manual rerun of reconcilier with mapping override; provisional credit computed €23,950 pending approval. Created accounting memo ACC-2026-02-GREEN-011.
2026-02-22 - Customer (VerdeHealth - Sophie Martin): Thanks for quick work. Please confirm when credit will appear and whether this will affect next cycle autopay.

2026-02-24 - Support (Luca Romero): Applied manual credit of €23,950 to VerdeHealth account; updated invoice and notified accounting to mark autopay exempt for adjustment. Root cause identified as proxy header strip; engineering PR merged to preserve X-Private-Origin on retries (see PR link).

2026-02-25 - Support (Luca): Ticket resolved. Sent follow-up runbook to Engagement and SRE: ensure postback forwarders preserve contract-related headers during failover and add automated alert if negotiated_rate lookup fails for >30m.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis: Missing 'private_origin' header on postbacks prevented billing reconciler from applying negotiated green-tier rate to the fallback window.
Evidence: Postback logs show 'missing tag' warnings and proxy logs indicate header removal during retry path. GitHub PR 722 updates forwarder to reattach origin headers when replaying through proxy.
Billing behavior: If no negotiated_rate_id found, system falls back to standard hosted tariff and no provisional credit is automatically queued. That gap explains the invoice delta.
Customer impact: One invoice cycle for VerdeHealth; net expected credit ~€23.95k covering dominated embedding tokens and streaming minutes for the fallback interval.
resolution: Applied manual credit of €23,950 to VerdeHealth's account on 2026-02-24 and updated the finalized invoice. Engineering merged fix to postback forwarder to preserve X-Private-Origin header during proxy retries (PR #722). Added an automated check in billing-reconciler to flag missing negotiated_rate lookups for >30 minutes and created INT-8812 to roll out smoke tests for hybrid fallback billing. Customer notified and accounting confirmed autopay will not reattempt the original overcharge.
